claims.claim_text: ZippyDB 原本讓上百萬 client 各自對數十萬台主機開 TLS 連線
claims.location: item-01 lede（H2「在資料庫前面加一層，連線的扇入不再跟著 client 數長」）
claims.evidence: A ZippyDB client might be one of more than a million hosts, owned by hundreds of teams, that we cannot change quickly. / A single client can touch tens of thousands of distinct shards in a stable window; those shards sit across hundreds of thousands of database hosts.
claims.note: 第二輪重抓 engineering.fb.com 原文確認：client 端唯一的量級陳述仍是 more than a million hosts。修正後的「上百萬」對應 more than a million（量級為百萬且以上），不再是原本「數百萬」那個來源沒有的量級；「數十萬台主機」維持與 hundreds of thousands of database hosts 逐字相符。與 hero lede 的「百萬 client」也一致。timeliness: volatile，來源只早一天，不需日期標註。

claims.claim_text: Meta 描述過一次事故：一個路由 bug 讓每個 client 對每個 shard 都開了連線，主機撞上 file descriptor 上限，整個 fleet 陷進重新啟動的迴圈
claims.evidence: In one incident a routing bug led every client to open a connection per shard, hosts breached their file-descriptor limit, and the fleet fell into a reboot loop.
claims.note: 逐句對應，因果鏈與來源一致。

claims.claim_text: 每台主機連線數降約 97 到 98%、總長連線數降約 19 倍，計算開銷約 6%，目前承載四成 ZippyDB 流量
claims.evidence: Per-host connection counts collapse by ~97–98%. / End to end, total persistent connections still drop by roughly 19x. / adding only about 6% computational overhead to an average use case. / It currently carries about 40% of all the ZippyDB traffic and is growing.
claims.note: 四個數字全部逐字對上，且 post 的「約」保留了來源的 ~ / roughly / about 語氣。timeliness: volatile（部署比例會變），來源只早一天。

claims.claim_text: 目前承載四成 ZippyDB 流量，能撐每秒十億次以上的操作
claims.evidence: It currently carries about 40% of all the ZippyDB traffic and is growing while adding only about 6% overhead to an average use case. / It can handle greater than 1 billion operations per second.
claims.note: 第二輪重抓確認來源仍把兩件事分開：40% 是現況流量佔比，1 billion ops/sec 是 can handle 的承載能力。修正後 post 用「能撐…以上的操作」對應 can handle，能力與現況吞吐量不再被並列成同一件事，語氣升級已消除。

claims.claim_text: ZGateway 是擺在中間的無狀態 proxy 層，跑的是 Meta 自家的 C++ ZippyDB client，負責終結 TLS、做 per-tenant 准入控制、把同 shard 的請求批次化與去重
claims.evidence: ZGateway is a stateless proxy tier between ZippyDB clients and the database (ZServer) fleet. / it runs our thick C++ client as its engine, one internal client per use case. / which terminates TLS, authorizes it against the use case's ACLs, and applies per-tenant admission control, validation, and shaping. / ZGateway resolves the shard, checks the local cache on a caching tier, and batches and coalesces misses and writes with other in-flight requests for that shard
claims.note: 四項機制逐項對上（stateless / thick C++ client / TLS + per-tenant admission control / batch + coalesce per shard）。

claims.claim_text: 接受 K 個型別參數的程序，在 N 種型別下最多會長出 N 的 K 次方份實體
claims.location: item-02 lede（H2「編譯期展開是指數的，執行期查表是線性的」）
claims.evidence: Each distinct sequence of argument types needs its own instantiation, so for `K` arguments there are on the order of `Nᵏ = 4ᵏ` combinations; adding a fifth type makes that `~5ᵏ`.
claims.note: 來源用 on the order of，post 用「最多會長出」，略強但仍在同一量級語氣內，不足以構成 inflated。

claims.claim_text: 他用一個四型別的列印系統示範，限制五個參數就是 1,365 份實體
claims.evidence: Consider a language with only 4 types (e.g. `int`, `float`, `string`, `bool`) and a variadic, parametrically polymorphic printing procedure. … suppose you never print more than 5 arguments, that allows up to 1365 instantiations.

claims.claim_text: 多一個型別變成 3,906 份，再放寬到六個參數就是 19,531 份
claims.evidence: suppose you never print more than 5 arguments, that allows up to 1365 instantiations. Add another type and it becomes 3906. Raise the maximum to 6 arguments and it becomes 19531.
claims.note: 第二輪重抓確認來源數列的三段配對：1365 = 4 型別 / 最多 5 參數；3906 = Add another type（5 型別）/ 仍 5 參數；19531 = 5 型別 / Raise the maximum to 6 arguments。修正後 post 的「多一個型別變成 3,906 份，再放寬到六個參數就是 19,531 份」逐段對上，中間漏掉的「加第五個型別」那一步已補回，19,531 不再被掛回四型別系統。算術亦自洽：sum 5^0..5^5 = 3906、sum 5^0..5^6 = 19531。

claims.claim_text: 文章的核心句子是 CTTI 的最壞情況「exponential, in three places at once」——語意檢查、程式碼產生、二進位大小三處同時爆
claims.evidence: CTTI's worst case is **exponential, in three places at once** (semantic checking, code generation, and binary size).
claims.note: 引號內字串逐字存在；三處的內容也逐項對應（semantic checking / code generation / binary size）。

claims.claim_text: RTTI 是一支程序走一張放在唯讀記憶體的型別表，程式碼大小固定，只有表隨型別數線性成長
claims.evidence: one procedure iterating over one table / The _code_ handling this runtime type information will always be the same size and shape, as the only thing that grows is the type-table itself.
claims.note: 三個子命題（一支程序走一張表 / 程式碼大小固定 / 只有表線性成長）都有對應原文；型別表置於唯讀資料區亦見於原文。timeliness: durable。

claims.claim_text: 60Hz 下一幀預算是 16.6 毫秒，扣掉瀏覽器自身開銷實務上只剩約 10 毫秒
claims.location: item-03 lede（H2「主執行緒的一幀，實際只剩十毫秒左右可以花」）
claims.evidence: On the most common 60Hz display, that means 60 frames per second, or about 16.6 milliseconds per frame. / Once the browser's own processing cost is subtracted, the practical budget is usually considered to be around 10 milliseconds.
claims.note: 兩個數字逐字對上；post 的「實務上只剩約 10 毫秒」保留了 usually considered / around 的軟度。這也是 hero lede 的支撐數字。

claims.claim_text: 而超過 50 毫秒的任務一般就算有問題
claims.evidence: A task that runs this long and holds the main thread is called a long task, and anything over 50 milliseconds is generally considered a problem.
claims.note: 逐字對應，含「一般」對 generally considered。

claims.claim_text: 文章示範一個 200 毫秒的阻塞任務會凍住所有互動
claims.evidence: If one JavaScript function runs for 200 milliseconds, then for those 200 milliseconds the browser can't repaint the screen or receive a click from the user
claims.note: 200 毫秒與「凍住互動」皆有原文支持。附帶一提：頁面上可互動的 demo 按鈕用的是 0.5s / 2s，200ms 是文中的說明例子——post 說的是「文章示範」，仍在支持範圍內。

claims.claim_text: CSS 動畫在 JavaScript 卡住時仍然順暢，正是因為它不在主執行緒上跑
claims.evidence: The CSS animation, on the other hand, keeps running / CSS animations run on the compositor thread
claims.note: 現象與因果（跑在 compositor thread 上）都有原文支持。

claims.claim_text: Go 1.24 起 map 底層改成 Swiss table
claims.location: item-04 lede（H2「Go 的 map 換成 Swiss table 之後，探測變成一次比八格」）
claims.evidence: Go 1.24 replaced that implementation with a design based on Swiss Tables
claims.note: 版本號逐字對上。timeliness: durable。

claims.claim_text: 每 8 個 key-value slot 組成一個 group，雜湊值拆成上 57 位的 H1 與下 7 位的 H2，H2 存進 control byte，查表時用 SIMD 一次比對 8 個 control byte 得到候選 bitmap
claims.evidence: a map stores up to 8 key-value pairs in a structure called a **group** / the upper 57 bits are called **H1**, and the lower 7 bits are called **H2** / H2 is the part stored in the control byte above a live slot / On AMD64, Go uses SIMD instructions to compare H2 `42` with those 8 control bytes at the same time… the result is a packed bitmap with one bit for each slot
claims.note: 57/7 位切分、control byte、SIMD 一次比八格、bitmap 逐項對上。post 未提「On AMD64」這個限定，但「用 SIMD」本身不算升級語氣。

claims.claim_text: 滿了之後走三角探測序列（+1、+2、+3⋯），保證每個 group 恰好走過一次；再上層用 directory 與 global/local depth 做可擴充雜湊，table 到 7/8 載入率就分裂
claims.evidence: Go moves by `+1`, then `+2`, then `+3`, wrapping around when it reaches the end of the table… Because the group count is a power of two, Go visits every group exactly once before the sequence repeats. / global depth（directory-level）與 local depth（per-table）以 extendible hashing 管理，於 7 / 8 載入率門檻分裂
claims.note: 探測序列與「恰好走過一次」逐字對上；directory / global-local depth / 7/8 分裂門檻亦見於原文。

claims.claim_text: Go 團隊的微基準是 map 操作最多快 60%，但整體應用的幾何平均 CPU 時間只改善約 1.5%
claims.evidence: In the Go team's microbenchmarks, map operations ran up to 60% faster than in Go 1.23 / Full application benchmarks showed a geometric mean CPU time improvement of around 1.5%.
claims.note: 兩個數字逐字對上，且 post 保留了「微基準 vs 整體應用」的對比與 up to / around 的軟度——這正是最容易被灌水的一組數字，此處沒有。timeliness: annual。

claims.claim_text: Azure SQL 團隊把 expand-and-contract 拆成六個階段走完：先用 ALTER TABLE 加可為 null 的新欄位，接著應用端同時寫新舊欄位，再用 TOP 1000 分批 UPDATE 回填歷史資料避免長鎖，然後靠 feature flag 分批把讀切到新欄位，停掉舊欄位的寫入，最後才 DROP COLUMN
claims.location: item-05 lede（H2「把一次 schema 變更拆成六段，中間不必停機」）
claims.evidence: 六階段依序為 Add new columns / Dual-write to old and new columns / Backfill existing rows / Move reads to new columns / Stop writing old columns / Validate and remove old schema。ALTER TABLE dbo.[User] ADD FirstName nvarchar(100) NULL, LastName nvarchar(100) NULL; / UPDATE TOP (1000) dbo.[User] SET … WHERE FirstName IS NULL OR LastName IS NULL; / ALTER TABLE dbo.[User] DROP COLUMN Name;
claims.note: 六個階段的數量與順序、可為 null 的 ALTER TABLE、TOP (1000) 分批 UPDATE、收尾的 DROP COLUMN 全部逐項對上。唯一略強的地方：feature flag 在來源是條件句「If your application supports staged rollout, canary deployment, or feature flags, this is a good place to use them.」，post 直述「靠 feature flag」；因該階段本就以此為建議手段，判為可接受，不另開 action。timeliness: durable。

claims.claim_text: 他們也提到用 Query Store 觀察舊欄位還有沒有人在讀，但同時說單一工具都不完整，要合併多種方法
claims.evidence: How to observe usage? Query Store is a good place to start because it can reveal recent queries still referencing the old column. Application logs, database logs, dependency metadata, and temporary Extended Events can also help identify active consumers. None is complete by itself, so combine approaches and use the tooling appropriate for your environment.
claims.note: 第二輪重抓確認：Query Store 在來源只是 a good place to start，且緊接著就是 None is complete by itself, so combine approaches。修正後的後半句「但同時說單一工具都不完整，要合併多種方法」逐句對應這兩處，原本把 Query Store 升級成第四階段單一決策門檻的說法已移除，來源本來就沒有指定任何單一判準。

claims.claim_text: Verisign 在 2026 年 4 月 15 日提案取消所有第三級 .name 網域，ICANN 於 7 月 28 日核准
claims.location: item-06 lede（H2「.name 第三級網域整層被取消，作者的站二月先消失」）
claims.evidence: On 15 April 2026 Verisign proposed the destruction of the entire 3rd level of the '.name' hierarchy / on 28 July 2026 ICANN approved this action
claims.note: 兩個日期與兩個主體逐字對上。timeliness: volatile，但來源只早一天。

claims.claim_text: 作者從註冊商的信裡才得知，而他的網域其實付到 2040 年。受影響的約有 22,000 個網域持有者
claims.evidence: I found out about this a few days ago when my registrar emailed me / registered and paid for until 2040 / I'm just one of 22,000 people who will lose their domains.
claims.note: 三項逐字對上；來源寫 22,000 people（持有者），post 寫「22,000 個網域持有者」，一致。

claims.claim_text: .name 第三級網域整層被取消，作者的站二月先消失
claims.evidence: On 15 April 2026 Verisign proposed the destruction of the entire 3rd level of the '.name' hierarchy in order to simplify their administration. / On 28 July 2026 ICANN approved this action. / I'm just one of 22,000 people who will lose their domains. / First, this website vanishes in February.
claims.note: 第三輪重抓 neil.fraser.name 原文，逐項對新標題：(1)「整層被取消」由 the destruction of the entire 3rd level of the '.name' hierarchy ＋ ICANN approved this action 直接支持，範圍及於全體而非作者一人，另有 I'm just one of 22,000 people who will lose their domains. 佐證；來源自己也把它當既成事實敘述，故「被取消」未升級語氣。(2)「作者的站二月先消失」現在把二月只掛在作者自己的站上，對應 First, this website vanishes in February.，第二輪標記的「把二月擴及整層」殘留已消除——來源確實沒有給整層的生效日，新標題也不再宣稱。(3)「二月」已不帶任何年份標記，第二輪「明年二月」殘留的年份推斷隨之消失：post 現在說的與來源的 in February 一字不多，年份由讀者依發表日自行補足，與英文原句的開放程度相同。新寫法在這兩點上都嚴格優於第二輪版本。唯一新增的細微歧義：「先」在來源是三項後果的排序（First, this website vanishes… / Second, my email address also disappears. / Third, all the IoT devices…），非指作者的站早於其他第三級網域下線；卡片內文接著談 email 失效，脈絡上讀作前者，但若要零歧義可考慮刪去「先」。屬措辭層級，不改變事實，不另開 action。timeliness: volatile，來源只早一天。

claims.claim_text: 用了二十五年的 email 位址失效之後，空出來的 fraser.name 可以被別人註冊——拿它去做帳號接管，而且沒有任何機制能列舉出有哪些服務綁著那個位址
claims.evidence: Nearly twenty-five years ago I registered neil.fraser.name to provide a stable presence on the Internet. / hijack hundreds of accounts that are linked to that address / there is no way to enumerate all accounts…which have been opened using this email address over the past quarter century
claims.note: 二十五年、帳號接管、無法列舉綁定服務三項皆有原文。來源寫 nearly twenty-five years，post 寫「二十五年」，屬四捨五入不改變意義。

claims.claim_text: 他強調 .name 不是那種來路不明的第三級操作方，而是跟 *.co.uk、*.ny.us 同性質、受規範的註冊管理機構
claims.evidence: .name is completely different [from dubious third-level operators]. It was setup exclusively as a 3rd-level operation…Exactly like *.ny.us, or *.co.uk.
claims.note: 兩個類比域名逐字對上，對比語氣（completely different）亦一致。

claims.claim_text: Docker 把 1988 年的 confused deputy 問題重新套到 coding agent 身上
claims.location: item-07 lede（H2「agent 的護欄，不能放在 agent 自己的迴圈裡」）
claims.evidence: In 1988, Norm Hardy described a problem that had been quietly breaking systems for years: the confused deputy. A program that takes action using its permissions instead of yours. / Today, every AI agent is that deputy.
claims.note: 年份與概念套用逐字對上。

claims.claim_text: agent 繼承使用者的憑證與 repo 權限，但行為是機率性的，會照著 support ticket、網頁、文件裡的指令走
claims.evidence: It inherits your authority: Your credentials, your repo access, your ability to call APIs. But its behavior is probabilistic. / They read material that is often out of our control: support tickets, web pages, documentation, and code written by strangers.
claims.note: 憑證/repo 權限、probabilistic、三種輸入來源逐項對上。

claims.claim_text: 他們舉的例子是一則惡意 GitHub issue 把 agent 誘去讀私有 repo，再用一個 PR 把內容送出去——護欄若寫在 harness 裡，agent 可以在同一個迴圈裡跟它談判
claims.evidence: Researchers showed last year that a single malicious issue filed in a public GitHub repo could steer a coding agent into reading a company's private repositories and publishing the contents in a pull request the agent opened itself. / Guardrails inside the harness are enforced in the same loop the agent is running. / A boundary the agent can negotiate with is not a boundary.
claims.note: 例子逐項對上（惡意 issue → 讀私有 repo → 自己開 PR 外送）。post 寫「他們舉的例子」，來源確實是引用他人研究後自己舉出，措辭無誤。

claims.claim_text: Docker 的主張是把強制點下沉到 runtime 層，也就是 process 執行、憑證使用、網路請求真正發生的地方，換到的是跨 harness 的單一政策與單一稽核紀錄
claims.evidence: the runtime, where processes execute, credentials get used, and requests leave the machine. / That makes it the one place where rules you define can be enforced across all your agents. / A policy you write up will apply to every harness. And every action, by all your agents, lands in one record: what ran, what it touched, which rule decided.
claims.note: 三個定位詞（process 執行 / 憑證使用 / 網路請求）逐項對上；單一政策與單一稽核紀錄亦有原文。

claims.claim_text: 1.31.5 把四件事一起放進來：predicate location 讓 location $var 用任何求值結果當比對條件，不再只看 URI；client_body_early_read 允許在 location 比對之前就緩衝並解析請求本體；新的 JSON parser 用 json_set $var $request_body "key" 把欄位直接抽進變數
claims.location: item-08 lede（H2「NGINX 讓 location 可以用變數當條件，也能先讀 body 再決定路由」）
claims.evidence: Any variable becomes a predicate when it's used in a `location` definition. / buffer and parse the request payload **before** location matching takes place / json_set $json_method $request_body "method" ;
claims.note: 版本 1.31.5 與四項功能（predicate location、client_body_early_read、JSON parser、Control API）數量與內容皆對上；json_set 的語法形狀與原文範例一致，post 用的是示意變數名。timeliness: annual（current version 陳述）。

claims.claim_text: 原本屬於 NGINX Plus 的 Control API 也進了開源版，走 /1/control/processes 與 /1/control/config 做執行期查詢與重新載入設定
claims.evidence: NGINX Control API (open-sourced from F5 NGINX Plus) / 端點為 `/1/control/processes` 與 `/1/control/config`；設定重新載入：curl --unix-socket /tmp/nginx.sock -X PATCH http://localhost/1/control/config
claims.note: 兩個端點路徑逐字對上，來源出處（NGINX Plus → 開源）亦然。

claims.claim_text: 前三者合起來的意思是 payload-direct routing——依 JSON 內容而不是端點路徑分流。Control API 沒有認證，官方的建議是綁在只有特權使用者能觸及的 UNIX domain socket 上
claims.evidence: Route requests to microservices based on specific JSON payload keys or MCP tool calls rather than generic endpoints like `/mcp`. / bind it to a UNIX domain socket on a path only privileged users can reach. It is an unauthenticated interface to NGINX internals, and it does not belong on a network port.
claims.note: "payload-direct routing" 一詞在原文中原樣出現；未認證與 UNIX domain socket 建議逐字對上。

claims.claim_text: MSTest 加上 source generation，在編譯期就把測試清單、建構測試類別與呼叫測試方法的委派、以及裁剪時要保留哪些型別的參照全部產生出來，取代執行期的 Assembly.GetTypes() 掃描
claims.location: item-09 lede（H2「測試也跟著 Native AOT 一起裁，才算測到出貨的那份」）
claims.evidence: A registry of the test classes in the assembly / Delegates that construct test classes and invoke test methods / References that preserve discovered test classes and supported base classes when trimming runs / avoids the assembly-wide `Assembly.GetTypes()` scan and reflective construction and invocation for supported tests
claims.note: 三項產出與被取代的 Assembly.GetTypes() 掃描逐項對上。

claims.claim_text: 應用程式若用 Native AOT 出貨，一次綠燈的 managed 測試 run 其實留了一個缺口——測的不是實際部署的那份
claims.evidence: If you ship an application with Native AOT, a green managed test run leaves a gap…The published application can therefore behave differently from the code exercised by the managed test process.
claims.note: 「綠燈的 managed 測試 run 留下缺口」幾乎是逐句翻譯，語氣未升級。

claims.claim_text: 開啟方式就是在專案檔把 PublishAot 設成 true；文章沒有給啟動時間或二進位大小的數字，並明說「Performance is secondary」
claims.evidence: <Project Sdk="MSTest.Sdk/4.4.0"><PropertyGroup><TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework><PublishAot>true</PublishAot></PropertyGroup></Project> / Performance is secondary, not the reason to test under the deployment model you ship.
claims.note: 引號內字串逐字存在；文章確實未給啟動時間或二進位大小數字（重抓確認）。最小設定除 PublishAot 外還需 MSTest.Sdk/4.4.0 與 TargetFramework，但那是專案本身的前提而非開關，post 的「就是」不構成錯述。timeliness: annual。

claims.claim_text: 現行 sparse attention 其中一條主流路線是靠外部 proxy score 先挑 token，每一步仍是 O(N)
claims.location: item-10 lede（H2「讓模型自己宣告要看哪一段 context」）
claims.evidence: A prominent approach mitigates this cost by pre-selecting relevant tokens via lightweight proxy scores, but this extrinsic scoring still incurs O(N) per step.
claims.note: 第二輪重抓 abstract 確認原句仍是 A prominent approach。修正後的「其中一條主流路線」對應 a prominent approach（其中一種主流做法），不再是原本「多半」那個來源沒做的全稱陳述；proxy score 預選與 O(N) per step 本來就逐字對上。範圍量詞的擴張已消除。

claims.claim_text: 這篇提出的 Declarative Attention 換個方向，讓模型在 chain-of-thought 裡自己宣告注意力範圍，分成 <global>、<focus>、<local> 三種模式，推論引擎像解析 tool call 一樣讀這些宣告，然後跳過大半 KV cache
claims.evidence: we introduce Declarative Attention (DA), a protocol that elicits the model to declare where it needs to attend within its chain-of-thought, partitioning generation into three modes: <global> (full context), <focus> (a specific region), and <local> (recent output only). The inference engine parses these declarations like tool calls and skips most of the KV cache read.
claims.note: 方法名、三個模式名稱、tool call 類比、skips most of the KV cache 全部逐字對上。

claims.claim_text: 在 15 項 long-context 任務的 zero-shot 評測裡，Gemma-4-31B 與 Qwen-3.6-27B 分別少讀 52.0% 與 31.1% 的 token，準確率各掉 1.27 與 2.75 個百分點
claims.evidence: Under zero-shot evaluation across 15 long-context tasks, DA on off-the-shelf models (Gemma-4-31B, Qwen-3.6-27B) significantly reduces total attended tokens during decoding (52.0%, 31.1%) with modest accuracy drops (1.27pp, 2.75pp)
claims.note: 任務數、兩個模型名、兩組減量、兩組掉點全部逐字對上，且順序配對正確（Gemma→52.0%/1.27pp，Qwen→31.1%/2.75pp）。timeliness: annual（v1 preprint）。

claims.claim_text: 作者說這個差距會隨模型規模縮小，而且整套方法不需要重訓——直接套在 off-the-shelf 模型上
claims.evidence: modest accuracy drops (1.27pp, 2.75pp) that shrink with model scale / DA on off-the-shelf models (Gemma-4-31B, Qwen-3.6-27B)
claims.note: 「隨模型規模縮小」逐字對上；「不需重訓」由 off-the-shelf models 支持，且 post 有掛上「作者說」的可見出處標記。
